After the [[Battle of Naboo]]<ref name="AOR" /> in [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> [[Dooku]], on the orders of his [[Sith Master]], came to the [[planet]] [[Sullust]] on a secret mission and met with [[SoroSuub Corporation]]'s representative [[Kap Klyp]]. Meanwhile, on a secret [[mission]], [[Jak'zin]], the [[Jedi Knight]], recognized Dooku and came to his side. After Dooku encountered with Jak'Zin, the two revealed to each other their respective secret missions. Later, they were surrounded by armed [[Gender|men]], but the duo killed them all. However, Dokku also killed Jak'Zin.<ref name="AOR" />
